_readme: SKYFALL -- a gate to the sky. You start at the helm of the Novurania 18 RHIB in the Merrimack
entrance at sunset, 330 m short of the box: drive east and you meet it. It is 200 m across and
120 m tall, and through it, instead of the far side of the river, is the Earth seen straight
down from 100 km up -- the Great Bahama Bank in daylight, turquoise shallows and islands.
It looks DOWN because the far end of the box leans. A gate is one structure posed twice, and
neither pose is locked upright: this one's exit is pitched 90 degrees over, so what you drive
into going east you leave going straight down -- and a window carries ray directions by the
same motor, which is why a level look into it is a look at the planet from orbit.
Drive in. The carry keeps your motion and turns it with the box, so the boat leaves the river
at twenty knots and arrives 100 km over the bank pointed at it, bow down (90 degrees of exit
less the bow-up trim it was planing at). Nothing rights it: a dry hull has no buoyancy and no
one is steering, so it tumbles the whole way.
IT DOES NOT FALL AT g FOR LONG. The hull carries windage -- the collar and console are drag
elements in air -- so it accelerates for about half a minute and then holds terminal velocity,
MEASURED at ~45 m/s (87 kn) tumbling. From 100 km that is a thirty-five minute fall at 1x, so
press Up twice (time x100) once you are through and it lands in about twenty seconds; press
Down to come back to real time. It arrives at 87 knots, upside down, and floats.
The camera follows the boat through the window and keeps its chase distance the whole way
down, so the fall is watched from behind the transom with the planet underneath.
Launch from the repo root:  build/bin/gagame.exe scenes/demos/skyfall.json
HELM   W / S  both throttles ahead / astern      A / D  steer to port / starboard
Q / E  split the levers (pivot)           Shift / Ctrl  trim out / in
T      leave the helm: the camera flies free (the boat keeps its throttles); T again returns
FLY    W A S D move, Q / E down / up, hold the right mouse button to look, wheel = speed
TIME   Space pause, Up / Down time x10 / /10, Left / Right nudge.   R reload shaders.
To land sooner instead of higher, lower the exit's `alt` below: at ~4000 m the fall is about
eighty seconds at 1x, and the window becomes a drone shot rather than a look from orbit.

sun._readme: The same placement the Haulover gate uses: the Merrimack at sunset (+1.5 deg) and the tropics in full daylight, so the window is a bright Earth in a dusk river.
